title.zh: Railway曝安全事件：部分密钥明文恐遭窃取，攻击疑似瞄准AI服务商

current_state.zh: Railway disclosed unauthorized activity in its environment-variable storage that may have exposed encrypted and possibly plaintext customer secrets, prompting all users to rotate keys and temporarily halting platform-wide builds and deployments.
